profile.headline: Senior Managing Consultant, Product Engineering at IBM
profile.jobTitle: Senior Managing Consultant, Digital Product Engineering
profile.summary:
I’m a full stack developer and technical leader with over a decade of experience building and delivering complex projects. Over the course of my career, I’ve worked across a wide range of technologies and industries, taking on roles that span from hands-on development to architecture and leadership. I have a strong background in building performant, scalable applications and I’m equally comfortable writing code, shaping system architecture, or rolling up my sleeves to solve tough technical challenges.

As a technical lead, I’ve partnered with business and technical stakeholders to shape requirements into actionable plans for development teams. I’ve also stepped into group and pod lead roles, mentoring engineers, guiding multi-vendor teams, and helping align delivery across large and often challenging environments. In release leadership roles, I’ve been responsible for coordinating deployments across dozens of teams, managing CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring smooth delivery at scale.

Earlier in my career, I worked in a global technical presales center where I built prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and immersive demos. I also had the chance to present regularly to clients, from technical contributors to CxOs at Fortune 500 companies, in workshops, critical reviews, sales meetings, and on conference floors.

No matter the role, I thrive in the space where design and engineering intersect. I’ve always believed the best results come when developers and designers collaborate closely rather than working in a handoff model. That philosophy has shaped the way I build teams, guide projects, and deliver solutions that not only work, but delight.

positions.title: Senior Managing Consultant, Digital Product Engineering
positions.description: Provide technical leadership and solution architecture for digital product design & engineering engagements.

positions.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
positions.description:
Proven engineering leader and architect with a track record of delivering complex platforms, guiding large cross-functional teams, and turning around at-risk projects through technical depth and resilient leadership:
- Delivered complex platform features, including a custom WYSIWYG editor with real-time editing, dynamic validation, multi-step flows, and flexible embedding.
- Drove technical leadership at scale by introducing enterprise-wide features, guiding SAFe planning cycles for development pod, mentoring engineers, and coordinating delivery across multi-vendor teams.
- Directed release management and CI/CD pipelines for large-scale web platforms, ensuring smooth, reliable deployments across dozens of pods.
- Turned around at-risk projects by rebuilding stakeholder trust, navigating enterprise security reviews, and engineering solutions around unstable integrations to deliver on time.

positions.title: Lead UX Developer, Market Team at Global Solution Center
positions.description:
Full-stack web application development with a focus on enterprise solutions and PoC's for the Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment industries in a technical presales role.

I collaborate with designers, business leaders and clients to formulate, create and deploy innovative UX applications, orchestrate service layers and integrate key components.

As the Lead UX Developer for my market team, I handle everything from full-stack development, UI creation, usability, establishing best practices, project/system management, being a git-magician, and I particularly enjoy tackling challenging algorithmic problems.

positions.title: Lead Developer, IBM Global Industry Solutions Center of Excellence
positions.description:
Technical and development leader responsible for the strategy, organization and execution of an internal cognitive tool for global sellers.  I was responsible for working with SME's, business leaders, and sponsor users to identify technological strategy, translate requirements into tasks, and work with the product owner to move our application to launch.

As scrum master and lead, I oversaw a widespread development team with members located in: Dallas, TX; Nice, France; Giza, Egypt; Beijing, China.

positions.title: Certified IT Specialist
positions.description:
Developed industry solutions, PoC's, and experiential demos with a focus on full stack web development, cloud, integration, business analytics & optimization (BAO) and social media analytics.

Development projects focused on solutions to industry-specific challenges and opportunities.  Primarily worked on Retail, Travel & Transportation, Industrial, and Energy & Utilities industries in a technical presales role, working and presenting directly with client executive and technical teams.
